result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code path as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. I haven't run either command, so the `-help` output and the `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html` creation are untested. `mvn -o -pl cli test` passed, but it only shows the cli module builds and its tests still pass.

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`:** I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE_DESCRIPTION`. The description says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `analyzeLandscape` is also listed in the no-argument usage overview, just before `updateLandscape`.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`:** The dispatch accepts either name and calls the existing `updateLandscape(args)`. `-help` prints the usage for whichever name was typed: `analyzeLandscape` shows its own description and `updateLandscape` keeps its own.
- **`README.md`:** It had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape command" section. It documents `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` as the name to use, notes that `updateLandscape` still works, and mentions `-help`.

Nothing is committed.
